tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Tu parles arabe ?” You can ask a yes/no question with rising intonation (Tu parles arabe ?) or with est-ce que (Est-ce que tu parles arabe ?).
B hears the question and answers with oui or non. After a negative question (Tu ne viens pas ?) a yes is si: “Si, je viens.” The verb tile is the infinitive: you choose the form.
With non, add the tile “ne … pas” around the verb (il n'est pas malade). je becomes j' before a vowel.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
